examples: For my birthday I received two bouquets.

senses.definition: A decoratively arranged bunch of something.
examples: Each table was adorned with a bouquet of giant balloons.

quotes.text: Aunt Cass rearranged the bouquet of spoons in the little vase on the table.

senses.definition: The scent of a particular wine.
examples: This Bordeaux has an interesting bouquet.

senses.definition: The middle note of a perfume.
examples: The remarkable flower bouquet lasts for hours until it dissolves into a sweet vanilla smell.

senses.definition: A compliment or expression of praise.

quotes.text: Since his early death in 1953, a cult, small and select, has grown up around him […]. This coterie maintains that Burns was a writer of near transcendent genius […] whose first novel received enormous bouquets from the critics but who was hounded to death by those same critics when they learned he was a fag.
